verdict.rationale: Check is an API-first payroll platform. Its documented API covers the core objects: companies, workplaces, employees, payrolls (create, preview, approve, delete), contractors, benefits and tax documents. It also offers a CLI and an MCP server for programmatic access. The docs say embedded Components can be swapped for custom UI, which implies the API backs what the UI does, but no explicit parity guarantee is given, and some functions (such as viewing webhook deliveries in the Console's Developer tab) are only documented as UI features. missing for 10: an explicit statement or matrix showing API-to-UI parity, evidence that Console and Component-only functions (e.g. report generation, QuickBooks integration setup, webhook management) are exposed via the API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
